steps.name: Task 088 generated Ada Choice execution (GNAT 16.1.0, all policies)
Execute generated Ada codec, all assertion policies
Execute repeated temporal codecs, both profiles and all policies
Execute inherited nested and Choice temporal composition
Execute combined repeated Choice and temporal codecs
Verify completed execution evidence
command:
set -euo pipefail
test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/task094/sources.sha256"
test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/task094-composition/sources.sha256"
test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/task094-combined/sources.sha256"
test "$(grep -lFx 'TASK094_CODEC_COMPLETE checks= 54 rejections= 17' "$RUNNER_TEMP/task094/"*-execute.log | wc -l)" -eq 6
test "$(grep -lFx 'TASK094_COMPOSITION_COMPLETE checks= 19 rejections= 3' "$RUNNER_TEMP/task094-composition/"*-execute.log | wc -l)" -eq 6
test "$(grep -lFx 'TASK094_COMBINED_COMPLETE checks= 26 rejections= 2' "$RUNNER_TEMP/task094-combined/"*-execute.log | wc -l)" -eq 6

steps.name: Execute named and direct DateTime codecs, all policies
Execute combined DateTime Choice and repeated Record codecs
Execute generated hexBinary consumer, all policies
Execute qualified non-OAM hexBinary consumer, all policies
Execute combined Binary Choice temporal consumers, both namespaces and all policies
Portable helper-demand naming regression
command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 scripts/test-task093-compiler-placement.py
python3 scripts/check-task093-helper-demand.py --family portable --compiler 16 --scratch "$RUNNER_TEMP/task093-c4-16" --generator "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/debug/ams-gra-codegen-oms"
sha256sum --check --quiet "$RUNNER_TEMP/task093-c4-16/sources.sha256"

steps.name: Validate mandatory evidence
command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$RUNNER_TEMP/task093-hexbinary"
test -s "$root/sources.json"
test -s "$root/model-byte-parity.json"
for policy in normal Check Ignore; do
  test -s "$root/$policy-alire.lock"
  test -s "$root/$policy-build.command.json"
  test -s "$root/$policy-gnat.log"
  grep -Fx 'TASK093_CODEC_COMPLETE cases= 33' "$root/$policy-run.log"
  grep -Fx 'TASK093_MODEL_COMPLETE cases= 6' "$root/$policy-model-run.log"
  grep -Fx 'TASK093_CODEC_COMPLETE cases= 33' "$RUNNER_TEMP/task093-qualified/$policy-run.log"
  grep -Fx 'TASK093_MODEL_COMPLETE cases= 6' "$RUNNER_TEMP/task093-qualified/$policy-model-run.log"
done
test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/task093-combined/sources.json"
test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/task093-combined/qualification.json"
for profile in oam qualified; do
  for policy in normal Check Ignore; do
    grep -Fx 'TASK093_COMBINED_COMPLETE checks= 49 rejections= 9' "$RUNNER_TEMP/task093-combined/$profile-$policy-run.log"
  done
done

Execute generated Duration consumers, all policies

Execute generated repeated Choice consumers, all policies

command:
set -euo pipefail
for profile in task092-codec task092-qualified; do
  test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/$profile/sources.sha256"
